theorem scopes_grant_access_spec (scopes : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (req : Slice U8) :
    token_scope.scopes_grant_access scopes req =
      ok (scopeGrants (scopes.val.map (fun s => nats s.val)) (nats req.val)) := by
  sorry

spec.name: nats
spec.code:
/-- A byte string as numbers. -/
def nats (v : List U8) : List Nat := v.map (·.val)

spec.name: scopeGrants
spec.code:
/-- `scopes_grant_access`: an exact match, a `*` or `admin` wildcard, or the
bare action parent (the text before the first `:`) of a colon-form
requirement, so `write` covers `write:artifacts`. -/
def scopeGrants (scopes : List (List Nat)) (req : List Nat) : Bool :=
  let parent := req.takeWhile (· ≠ 58)
  scopes.contains (lit "*") || scopes.contains (lit "admin") || scopes.contains req ||
    (req.contains 58 && !parent.isEmpty && scopes.contains parent)

/-- The UTF-8 bytes of a literal. -/
def lit (s : String) : List Nat := s.toUTF8.toList.map (·.toNat)

def token_scope.scopes_grant_access
  (scopes : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) (required_scope : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 42#u8 ]))
  let b ← strs.any_eq scopes s
  let has_admin_wildcard ←
    if b
    then ok true
    else
      do
      let s1 ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 5#usize [ 97#u8, 100#u8, 109#u8, 105#u8, 110#u8 ]))
      strs.any_eq scopes s1
  let b1 ← strs.any_eq scopes required_scope
  if b1
  then ok true
  else
    if has_admin_wildcard
    then ok true
    else
      let o ← strs.split_once required_scope 58#u8
      match o with
      | none => ok false
      | some p =>
        let (parent, _) := p
        let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len parent
        if i > 0#usize
        then let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref parent
             strs.any_eq scopes s1
        else ok false

def strs.split_once
  (s : Slice Std.U8) (sep : Std.U8) :
  Result (Option ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)))
  := do
  let o ← strs.find_byte s sep
  match o with
  | none => ok none
  | some i =>
    let v ← strs.sub s 0#usize i
    let i1 ← i + 1#usize
    let i2 := Slice.len s
    let v1 ← strs.sub s i1 i2
    ok (some (v, v1))
